title: OpenAPI server variable default under a credential name
summary: A server URL template with a variable named like a credential, for example a variable apiKey inside the host or path, whose required default is a literal. No fixture is authored.
rationale: A Server Variable Object requires a default that shall be sent when no other value is supplied, so a default is not documentation-only: it is substituted into the URL. The OpenAPI Initiative's own guide uses the same slot for ordinary metadata (a username default of demo, a port, a version). Whether a credential-named variable's default is a public selector, a placeholder or a private value is not stated anywhere in the sources, and the slot is not covered by the userinfo, query-string or signed-URL cases because the secret may sit before substitution. The ordinary-metadata twin (username, port and version defaults taken from the guide) is not asserted here either, because the guide describes the username value as assigned by the service provider without saying it is public.

expectation.rationale: Unresolved. The specification says the default shall be sent if an alternate value is not supplied, which makes a literal default part of the request URL; it does not say the value is public or secret, and the guide's description that the username value is assigned by the service provider does not settle that either. Candidate outcomes: not flagged for selector-like values such as a port or an API version; flagged when the default is a value whose grammar establishes a credential; the opaque literal under a credential-named variable needs a maintainer decision (project-policy with a non-author reviewer) or a statement by the API's provider. Planned fixture, not built: the guide's three-variable template with the variable renamed apiKey and an obviously fake default. Variable substitution into a full URL (and any redaction of the resulting URL) is tool behavior the sources do not specify; it is a precondition and a credential-eval follow-up, never an assumed capability.

sources.supports: Server Variable Object default: REQUIRED. The default value to use for substitution, which shall be sent if an alternate value is not supplied; if enum is defined, the value must exist in the enum's values.
A Server Object url supports Server Variables; variable substitutions are made when a variable is named in {braces}.
In the guide's example the username variable has default demo and the description 'This value is assigned by the service provider.'

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Authored from the cited pages read on 2026-10-04, before any scanner was consulted. The OpenAPI Specification is a standard with no issuing provider; it is cited only for its own text, never for what any provider issues. Reference resolution, example generation, request-sample generation and masking are tool behaviors owned downstream (credential-eval, #150); no scanner or adapter capability is assumed.
